discription: A simple plucked string-like sound using filtered white noise and a short decay envelope, reminiscent of a Karplus-Strong algorithm.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, decay=0.5, brightness=0.5; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.05, 0.5, decay, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = WhiteNoise.ar(amp * 0.5); sig = LPF.ar(sig, freq * (1 + (brightness * 2))); sig = CombN.ar(sig, 0.1, 1/freq, decay); sig = sig * env * amp; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
